name: Samurai
summary: A disciplined warrior whose fighting spirit can't be broken.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.short: One of History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion.
features.summary: You gain proficiency in one of the listed skills (or one language).

features.name: Fighting Spirit
features.short: Bonus action: advantage on attacks and temp HP.
features.summary: As a bonus action, you gain advantage on weapon attack rolls until the end of the turn and 5 temporary hit points (10 at 10th, 15 at 15th). Three uses per long rest.

features.name: Elegant Courtier
features.short: Add WIS to Persuasion; WIS save proficiency.
features.summary: When you make a Charisma (Persuasion) check, add your Wisdom modifier. You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws (or Intelligence or Charisma if you already have it).

features.name: Tireless Spirit
features.short: Regain a Fighting Spirit use at initiative if you have none.
features.summary: When you roll initiative and have no uses of Fighting Spirit left, you regain one.

features.name: Rapid Strike
features.short: Trade advantage for an extra attack.
features.summary: If you have advantage on a weapon attack against a creature on your turn, you can forgo it to make an additional attack against that creature as part of the same action. Once per turn.

features.name: Strength before Death
features.short: At 0 HP, take an extra turn before falling.
features.summary: When you take damage that reduces you to 0 hit points and doesn't kill you outright, you can use your reaction to delay falling unconscious and take an extra turn immediately. Once per long rest.
